evidence: Independent coordinator/reviewer decoding from whole mapped function starts confirms DEC ECX; SHL ECX,16; MOV CX,u_fraction; MOV ESP,ECX; then unconditional pixel iteration, ADD SP,du_fraction, SUB ESP,0x10000 and JNS. Anchors: 61A6BA..6FF, 61ABBA..BFF and 623E6A..EEA. ADD SP cannot propagate carry into the high-word counter. For n16=uint16(end-start), output iterations equal n16 for 1..32769 and one otherwise; raw-span admission remains unchanged before clipping.

Original 61A6F6, 61ABF6 and 623EB2/623EE1 also preload the next texel before testing the terminating count. The current ordinary C++ reconstruction omits that unused final read. Preserve this known fault/read-observation difference; do not label it equivalent or add a volatile/emission-only anchor merely to manufacture the machine trace. Valid source storage and callback/shared-scratch/FP-status boundaries remain unproved beyond existing evidence.
